HomeServices

Specialized Energy & Field Services

Full-spectrum engineering, maintenance, drilling support, and turnkey solutions engineered to maximize asset uptime and operational efficiency.

Oil & Gas Field Services

Comprehensive site preparation, flowline management, wellhead surface maintenance, and onshore field support.

  • Wellhead hook-up and surface gathering manifold installation
  • Flowline inspection, pigging, and corrosion mitigation
  • Field camp civil works, desert pad grading, and security fencing

Drilling Support Services

Rig mobilization, mud logging support, directional drilling equipment handling, and rig site utility systems.

  • Turnkey drilling rig moves and heavy camp relocation
  • Mud tank cleaning, cutting containment, and disposal support
  • Drill pipe inspection, tubular handling, and thread protection

Well Maintenance & Completion

Well workover support, slickline, casing inspection, and artificial lift maintenance to optimize reservoir productivity.

  • Christmas tree valve rebuilds and gate replacements
  • Slickline mechanical operations and downhole gauge runs
  • ESP (Electric Submersible Pump) commissioning & drive troubleshooting

Mechanical Overhaul & Maintenance

Turbine inspection, compressor overhauls, centrifugal pump rebuilds, heat exchanger servicing, and plant turnaround support.

  • Gas turbine hot-gas-path inspections and alignment
  • Multistage crude injection and booster pump overhauls
  • Shell & tube heat exchanger retubing, chemical flushing

Electrical & Power Systems

High-voltage switchgear testing, oilfield generator maintenance, substations, motor control centers (MCC), and solar hybrid setups.

  • 11kV - 33kV switchgear maintenance and relay calibration
  • Prime power diesel & gas generator load bank testing
  • Hazardous area ATEX lighting and earthing grid testing

Instrumentation, Automation & Control

SCADA systems, PLC programming, calibration of pressure/flow transmitters, ESD systems, and distributed control systems (DCS).

  • Custody transfer fiscal metering calibration and verification
  • Emergency Shutdown (ESD) and Fire & Gas (F&G) validation
  • Pneumatic, hydraulic, and smart motorized valve actuators

Engineering & Technical Consultancy

FEED studies, pipeline integrity assessments, structural evaluations, flow assurance, and field optimization engineering.

  • FEED and detailed engineering design for facility modifications
  • Pipe stress analysis and hydrostatic pressure rating audits
  • Corrosion control modeling and cathodic protection surveys

Procurement & Spare Parts Supply

Direct supply of API-certified valves, pipes, flanges, instrumentation spare parts, and specialized heavy consumables.

  • API 6D ball, check, and gate valves with Mill Test Certificates
  • OEM mechanical seals, bearings, impellers, and gaskets
  • Heavy oilfield electrical switchgear components and transmitters

Heavy Equipment & Machinery Rental

Heavy-duty rough terrain cranes, bulldozers, excavators, heavy prime movers, generators, and certified lifting equipment.

  • 50T to 220T all-terrain and crawler cranes with certified operators
  • Caterpillar D8/D9 bulldozers, graders, and trenchers for desert work
  • High-capacity trailer beds, low-loaders, and heavy oilfield skids

Field Logistics & Heavy Transport

Desert haulage, rig moving convoys, hazardous materials logistics, remote camp provisioning, and secure desert transport.

  • Scheduled convoy haulage from coastal ports to inland desert fields
  • Over-dimensional load transport permits and route route-scouting
  • Fuel, water, and essential consumables supply logistics

Industrial Turnkey Services

End-to-end EPC project execution, manifold installations, separation facility construction, and complete plant commissioning.

EPC DeliveryEngineering, procurement, fabrication, and site construction.
CommissioningSystem hydrotesting, inerting, loop checking, and startup.
Lifecycle SupportLong-term maintenance agreements and emergency call-outs.
